title.zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入物窃取助记词事件
title.en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident

current_state.zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。
current_state.en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Ledger盗币黑客向Tornado Cash转入107万美元ETH，部分资金流入Binance热钱包
updates.title_en: ⚡️Ledger盗币黑客向Tornado Cash转入107万美元ETH，部分资金流入Binance热钱包
updates.what_changed_zh: 嫌疑人通过 4 个钱包向 Tornado Cash 转入 430.2 ETH（约 107 万美元），并在 Tether 冻结后通过 SUN.io 及 USDD PSM 将 USDT 兑换为 USDD，部分资金流入 Binance 热钱包；相关钱包仍持有约 7060 万美元资产。
updates.what_changed_en: Suspects moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) to Tornado Cash via 4 wallets, and after Tether's freeze converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with some funds routed to a Binance hot wallet; suspect wallets still hold ~$70.6M.
updates.current_state_zh: 与 Ledger 相关的供应链攻击事件确认损失近 9000 万美元，MistTrack 正在追踪资金，Tether 已冻结相关地址中的大量 USDT；最新链上监测显示嫌疑人已向 Tornado Cash 转入 430.2 ETH（约 107 万美元），并通过 SUN.io 及 USDD PSM 将 USDT 兑换为 USDD，部分资金流入 Binance 热钱包，相关钱包仍持有约 7060 万美元资产；设备篡改与攻击者身份仍未证实。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger-related supply-chain attack has confirmed losses approaching $90 million, with MistTrack tracking funds and Tether freezing substantial USDT; latest on-chain monitoring shows suspects moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) to Tornado Cash and converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with some funds routed to a Binance hot wallet, while suspect wallets still hold ~$70.6M; device tampering and attacker identity remain unconfirmed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Suspects in the ~$90M Ledger distributor theft moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) into Tornado Cash and, after Tether froze assets, converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with part of the funds routed to a Binance hot wallet while roughly $70.6M in traced assets reportedly remains in suspect wallets.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Suspects in the ~$90M Ledger distributor theft moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) into Tornado Cash and, after Tether froze assets, converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with part of the funds routed to a Binance hot wallet while roughly $70.6M in traced assets reportedly remains in suspect wallets.
updates.background_zh: Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币协议，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机（EVM）的网络之上，用于切断资金来源与去向地址之间的链上关联；美国财政部曾于 2022 年 8 月将其列入黑名单，2024 年 11 月美国联邦上诉法院推翻了这一裁定。USDD 的 PSM（锚定稳定模块）是 USDD 内置的固定汇率兑换功能，可在 USDD 与支持的稳定币之间按 1:1 比例兑换。
updates.background_en: Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses; the U.S. Treasury blacklisted it in August 2022, and a U.S. federal appeals court overturned that ruling in November 2024. The USDD PSM (Peg Stability Module) is USDD's built-in fixed-rate swap feature that converts between USDD and supported stablecoins at a 1:1 rate.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事显示出稳定币发行方的冻结权会推动被盗资金转向 USDD 等替代稳定币以及 Tornado Cash 等混币工具，这一路径涉及 USDT/USDD 兑换流动性以及流入 Binance 等中心化交易所热钱包的资金。据称仍留在嫌疑钱包中的约 7060 万美元资产，是后续链上资金传导的主要观察点。
updates.market_impact_en: The episode illustrates how stablecoin issuer freeze powers can push stolen funds toward alternative stablecoins such as USDD and toward mixers like Tornado Cash, a channel that touches USDT/USDD swap liquidity and deposits into centralized-exchange hot wallets such as Binance's. The reported ~$70.6 million still sitting in suspect wallets is the main on-chain transmission point to watch.

updates.title_zh: Ledger 称东南亚经销商与 8600 万美元盗取事件有关
updates.title_en: Ledger says Southeast Asia reseller linked to $86M draining
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 官方确认正在调查与经销商 CryptoBilis 相关的供应链攻击，并要求 CryptoBilis 暂停所有 Ledger 设备的销售和发货；建议过去 90 天从 CryptoBilis 购买设备的用户不要进行初始化设置，若已设置则把资产转移到新的 Ledger 签名器。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger confirmed it is investigating a supply-chain compromise tied to Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which has been linked to over $80 million drained from users who bought Ledger devices through it, prompting advice to affected buyers to move assets to a new signer.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger confirmed it is investigating a supply-chain compromise tied to Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which has been linked to over $80 million drained from users who bought Ledger devices through it, prompting advice to affected buyers to move assets to a new signer.

updates.title_zh: Ledger 黑客恐慌规模接近 9000 万美元，Tether 着手冻结被盗 USDT
updates.title_en: Ledger hack scare nears $90 million as Tether moves to freeze stolen USDT
updates.what_changed_zh: 行业人士开始公开介入调查：币安创始人赵长鹏警告用户谨慎，称事件似乎局限于单一供应商的供应链攻击；前 Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès 正在调查是否有恶意硬件组件被植入发给客户的设备，并要求 CryptoBilis 打开部分未售出的 Ledger 钱包检查内部电路板。此外，报道指出 Ledger 的 Genuine Check 只能验证安全芯片，可能无法发现硬件其他部位的物理篡改。
updates.what_changed_en: Industry figures publicly intervened: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao warned users and said the incident appears localized to a single-vendor supply-chain attack; former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès is investigating whether malicious hardware components were implanted in customer devices and asked CryptoBilis to open some unsold Ledger wallets for circuit-board inspection. Reports also note Ledger's Genuine Check verifies the Secure Element but may not detect physical modifications elsewhere in the hardware.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 正在调查与东南亚授权经销商 CryptoBilis 相关的用户资金损失事件；Ledger 已要求 CryptoBilis 暂停销售和发货，并对过去90天内购买设备的客户发出警示。链上研究人员估计相关损失约为7200万至9000万美元，Tether 已冻结相关 USDT。赵长鹏等业内人士公开评论并呼吁行业协助追踪资金，Mark Karpelès 正调查设备是否植入恶意硬件组件，但攻击方式、设备是否被篡改及攻击者身份仍未确认，调查仍在进行中。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger is investigating reported fund losses tied to Southeast Asian authorized reseller CryptoBilis; Ledger has asked CryptoBilis to suspend sales and shipments and warned customers who bought devices in the past 90 days. Onchain researchers estimate losses at roughly $72 million to $90 million, and Tether has frozen related USDT. updates.what_changed_zh: 数周前从欧洲官方经销商处购买的一台Ledger硬件钱包被发现含有未经授权的间谍植入物，其可疑接线在正品设备中并不存在，表明销售前曾遭物理篡改，目前亚洲、南美和欧洲均报告了疑似案例，迄今尚无资金被盗。
updates.what_changed_en: A Ledger hardware wallet bought weeks earlier from an official European reseller was found to contain an unauthorized spy implant with suspicious wiring not present in genuine units, indicating physical tampering before sale, with suspected cases now reported across Asia, South America and Europe and no funds stolen so far.
updates.current_state_zh: 数周前从欧洲官方经销商处购买的一台Ledger硬件钱包被发现含有未经授权的间谍植入物，其可疑接线在正品设备中并不存在，表明销售前曾遭物理篡改，目前亚洲、南美和欧洲均报告了疑似案例，迄今尚无资金被盗。

updates.detailed_summary_en: A Ledger hardware wallet bought weeks earlier from an official European reseller was found to contain an unauthorized spy implant with suspicious wiring not present in genuine units, indicating physical tampering before sale, with suspected cases now reported across Asia, South America and Europe and no funds stolen so far.
updates.background_zh: 10 月 9 日，Ledger 表示正在调查与东南亚经销商所售设备相关的资金被盗报告，同期分析机构追踪到数千万美元规模的疑似资金流出，Ledger 要求 CryptoBilis 暂停所有销售和发货。CryptoBilis 被列为 Ledger 在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的官方经销商。
updates.background_en: On October 9, Ledger said it was investigating reports of stolen funds linked to devices sold through a Southeast Asian reseller, while analysts tracked tens of millions of dollars in suspected drains and Ledger asked CryptoBilis to pause all sales and shipments. CryptoBilis is listed as an official Ledger reseller for Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响自托管硬件钱包这一细分领域：若通过第三方经销商购买的设备可能携带可绕过标准验证的植入装置，风险认知将转向官方直购渠道，并可能影响经销商渠道的硬件钱包需求，进而波及更广泛的自托管安全叙事。
updates.market_impact_en: The report bears on the self-custody hardware-wallet segment: if devices bought through third-party resellers can carry implants that defeat standard attestation checks, risk perception shifts toward direct-from-vendor purchasing and can affect demand for wallets distributed through reseller channels, feeding into the broader self-custody security narrative.

updates.title_zh: Ledger 钱包植入事件暴露其真伪验证漏洞
updates.title_en: Ledger wallet implant exposes a gap in its authenticity check
updates.what_changed_zh: 独立调查将疑似盗损估计更新为约9320万美元、涉及六条链上315个钱包，并披露Ledger Genuine Check仅验证安全元件，无法检测安全元件仍完好的物理植入；Tibane Labs还记录了三代Nano X植入物，但其样本购自日本市场而非CryptoBilis。
updates.what_changed_en: Independent investigators updated the suspected theft estimate to about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains, and disclosed that Ledger's Genuine Check only verifies the secure element and cannot detect physical implants when that element remains intact; Tibane Labs also documented three generations of Nano X implants, though its specimens came from Japanese marketplaces rather than CryptoBilis.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入事件仍在调查中：Ledger确认一名受影响用户的设备存在未经授权的硬件植入，CryptoBilis已暂停所有硬件钱包销售；独立估计称疑似盗损约9320万美元，涉及六条链上315个钱包，而Genuine Check仅能验证安全元件，无法识别保持安全元件完好的物理植入。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply chain implant incident remains under investigation: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected user's device, CryptoBilis has suspended all hardware wallet sales, and independent estimates put suspected losses at about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains, while Genuine Check only verifies the secure element and cannot detect physical implants that leave it intact.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger has confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer's wallet — a case that exposes a blind spot in its Genuine Check authenticity verification that only attests the secure element — while independent investigators estimate $93.2M in suspected thefts across 315 wallets on six chains and authorized reseller CryptoBilis suspends all hardware wallet sales pending the investigation.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger has confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer's wallet — a case that exposes a blind spot in its Genuine Check authenticity verification that only attests the secure element — while independent investigators estimate $93.2M in suspected thefts across 315 wallets on six chains and authorized reseller CryptoBilis suspends all hardware wallet sales pending the investigation.

updates.title_zh: Ledger称CryptoBilis案件影响有限，已追踪到高达9300万美元，冻结1000万美元
updates.title_en: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93M is traced, $10M frozen
updates.what_changed_zh: Tether冻结了与Ledger硬件钱包盗取事件相关的1000万美元USDT；Bitquery称截至10月11日约8100万美元仍可在链上追踪，部分资金已通过Tornado Cash和Zcash转移；YFarmX给出更高估计，称9450万美元来自521个地址、跨越七个区块链。
updates.what_changed_en: Tether froze $10 million in USDT tied to the Ledger hardware-wallet thefts; Bitquery said about $81 million was still traceable onchain as of Oct. 11 with some funds moved through Tornado Cash and Zcash; YFarmX gave a higher estimate of $94.5 million from 521 addresses across seven blockchains.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入与盗取事件仍在调查中：Ledger确认至少一台设备存在未经授权的硬件植入，并称已确认案件均限于CryptoBilis销售的设备；独立估计在约9320万美元（315个钱包、六条链）至9450万美元（521个地址、七条链）之间，Tether已冻结1000万美元USDT，约8100万美元仍可在链上追踪，部分资金经Tornado Cash和Zcash转移；Ledger建议CryptoBilis客户不要初始化未使用设备，已使用设备的用户应转移到使用新恢复短语的新设备。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet supply-chain implant and theft incident remains under investigation: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in at least one device and says all confirmed cases involve devices sold by CryptoBilis; independent estimates range from about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains to $94.5 million across 521 addresses on seven chains, Tether has frozen $10 million in USDT, about $81 million remains traceable onchain, and some funds moved through Tornado Cash and Zcash; Ledger advised CryptoBilis customers not to set up unused devices and told those already using one to move assets to a new device with a newly generated recovery phrase.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger says confirmed CryptoBilis-linked compromises are limited while investigators trace as much as $93.2M in stolen crypto from affected hardware wallets and Tether freezes $10M in USDT, urging customers to avoid unused devices and migrate funds to newly generated recovery phrases.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger says confirmed CryptoBilis-linked compromises are limited while investigators trace as much as $93.2M in stolen crypto from affected hardware wallets and Tether freezes $10M in USDT, urging customers to avoid unused devices and migrate funds to newly generated recovery phrases.

updates.title_zh: Ledger间谍软件恐慌蔓延至东南亚以外
updates.title_en: Ledger spyware scare spreads beyond Southeast Asia
updates.what_changed_zh: 与 CryptoBilis 相关的 Ledger 钱包篡改事件已蔓延至东南亚以外，欧洲和南美也报告了带间谍软件的设备，包括来自德国 MediaMarkt 和菲律宾 LazMall 的官方经销商；Mark Karpelès 识别出可读取屏幕输出、绕过 Ledger Genuine Check 的间谍软件；Ledger 确认 10 月 9 日事件影响有限数量的 CryptoBilis 设备；CryptoBilis 前 CEO Arravind Prabu 表示公司已被收购、自己已卸任，前员工签署了保密条款。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger wallet tampering linked to CryptoBilis has spread beyond Southeast Asia, with spyware-fitted devices reported in Europe and South America, including from official resellers MediaMarkt (Germany) and LazMall (Philippines); Mark Karpelès identified spyware able to read screen output and bypass Ledger's Genuine Check; Ledger confirmed the October 9 incident affected a limited number of CryptoBilis devices; former CryptoBilis CEO Arravind Prabu says the firm was acquired, he stepped down, and former staff signed a confidentiality clause.
updates.current_state_zh: CryptoBilis 相关 Ledger 钱包盗取事件已涉及多地区，间谍软件篡改设备在亚洲、欧洲和南美被指认；Ledger 确认 10 月 9 日事件影响有限数量的 CryptoBilis 设备，损失超过 8600 万美元（Bitquery 此前估计 9320 万美元，约 1000 万美元被冻结），Ledger 仍在调查且未向受影响买家提供赔偿计划；CryptoBilis 前 CEO 称公司已被收购并已卸任。
updates.current_state_en: The CryptoBilis-linked Ledger wallet drain incident now spans multiple regions, with spyware-tampered devices alleged in Asia, Europe, and South America; Ledger confirmed the October 9 incident affected a limited number of CryptoBilis devices, losses exceed $86 million (Bitquery previously estimated $93.2 million with about $10 million frozen), Ledger continues to investigate and offers no repayment plan to affected buyers; former CryptoBilis CEO says the firm was acquired and he stepped down.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tampered Ledger hardware wallets fitted with physical spyware have been identified across Asia, Europe, and South America after users who bought from reseller CryptoBilis lost over $86 million.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tampered Ledger hardware wallets fitted with physical spyware have been identified across Asia, Europe, and South America after users who bought from reseller CryptoBilis lost over $86 million.

updates.title_zh: Ledger称疑似8700万美元盗币事件中所有已确认案例均与经销商CryptoBilis有关
updates.title_en: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 在 72 小时更新中表示，钱包盗取事件所有已确认案例均涉及经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的硬件钱包；CryptoBilis 已停止全部硬件钱包销售；Ledger 称自身系统和直销渠道未受影响，正与主管部门合作，并提醒授权经销商不得将退回产品重新上架。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's 72-hour update says every confirmed case in the wallet-draining incident involves hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis; CryptoBilis has ceased all hardware wallet sales; Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected, is working with authorities, and reminds authorized resellers never to restock returned products.
updates.current_state_zh: CryptoBilis 相关 Ledger 钱包盗取事件已涉及多地区，间谍软件篡改设备在亚洲、欧洲和南美被指认；Ledger 确认 10 月 9 日事件影响有限数量的 CryptoBilis 设备，损失超过 8600 万美元（Bitquery 此前估计 9320 万美元，约 1000 万美元被冻结），Ledger 仍在调查且未向受影响买家提供赔偿计划；CryptoBilis 前 CEO 称公司已被收购并已卸任，CryptoBilis 已停止全部硬件钱包销售；Ledger 在 72 小时更新中称所有已确认案例均涉 CryptoBilis 设备，自身系统与直销渠道未受影响，正与主管部门合作并警告经销商不得重新上架退回产品；一名买家报告从 MediaMarkt 发现第二台被篡改的 Ledger 设备，点名经销商 Aqipa，呼吁召回，并将设备送交 Ledger 分析。
updates.current_state_en: The CryptoBilis-linked Ledger wallet drain incident now spans multiple regions, with spyware-tampered devices alleged in Asia, Europe, and South America; Ledger confirmed the October 9 incident affected a limited number of CryptoBilis devices, losses exceed $86 million (Bitquery previously estimated $93.2 million with about $10 million frozen), Ledger continues to investigate and offers no repayment plan to affected buyers; former CryptoBilis CEO says the firm was acquired and he stepped down, and CryptoBilis has ceased all hardware wallet sales; in a 72-hour update, Ledger said all confirmed cases involve CryptoBilis devices, its own systems and direct channels are unaffected, it is working with authorities, and it warned resellers not to restock returned products; a buyer reports a second tampered Ledger device from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, calls for a recall, and sends the device to Ledger for analysis.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger's 72-hour update states that every confirmed case in the suspected $87M wallet-draining incident traces back to hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis, which has now stopped all hardware wallet sales, while Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger's 72-hour update states that every confirmed case in the suspected $87M wallet-draining incident traces back to hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis, which has now stopped all hardware wallet sales, while Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected.

updates.title_zh: Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传
updates.title_en: Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 安全团队发布硬件植入事件最新调查进展，确认 CryptoBilis 销售的部分 Ledger 设备外壳内被植入未授权硬件，可在初始化时读取屏幕并截取 24 个助记词，再通过内置微控制器与 eSIM 经 LTE 外传；该组件不修改 Secure Element 或 Ledger OS，也不干预交易签名。Ledger 同时表示尚未确认受影响用户总数及损失金额，网上流传数字未经官方核实。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's security team released the latest investigation update on the hardware implant incident, confirming that some Ledger devices sold by CryptoBilis contained unauthorized hardware implanted inside the casing that can read the screen and capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization, then exfiltrate it over LTE via an embedded microcontroller and eSIM; the component does not modify the Secure Element or Ledger OS and does not interfere with transaction signing. Ledger also said it has not confirmed the total number of affected users or loss amount, and circulating online figures are unverified.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 确认 CryptoBilis 渠道设备存在硬件植入，植入物通过读取屏幕截取 24 个助记词并经 LTE/eSIM 外传，且不触碰 Secure Element 或交易签名；10 月 9 日事件所有已确认损失均与 CryptoBilis 渠道设备有关，其他渠道暂未核实；CryptoBilis 已暂停销售 Ledger 产品；Ledger 称受影响用户总数及损失金额尚未确认，网上数字未经官方核实，建议未初始化设备不要设置、已设置用户转移资产并生成新助记词，调查仍在继续。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger has confirmed hardware implants in CryptoBilis-channel devices; the implant reads the screen to capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization and exfiltrates it over LTE/eSIM without touching the Secure Element or transaction signing; all confirmed losses from the October 9 incident are linked to CryptoBilis-channel devices, while other channels remain unverified; CryptoBilis has suspended sales of Ledger products; Ledger says the total affected-user count and loss amount are not yet confirmed, online figures are unverified, and it advises users not to initialize uninitialized devices and for already-configured users to move assets and generate new seed phrases; the investigation continues.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger confirmed that some hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis contained unauthorized implants that read the screen to capture 24-word seed phrases during initialization and exfiltrate them over LTE via an embedded eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the October 9 theft linked to that sales channel.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger confirmed that some hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis contained unauthorized implants that read the screen to capture 24-word seed phrases during initialization and exfiltrate them over LTE via an embedded eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the October 9 theft linked to that sales channel.

updates.title_zh: 新加坡机场所购Ledger Flex被确认植入间谍模块，硬件钱包供应链风险扩大
updates.title_en: 新加坡机场所购Ledger Flex被确认植入间谍模块，硬件钱包供应链风险扩大
updates.what_changed_zh: Mark Karpelès通过拆解图片和视频确认，在新加坡机场Metapod购买的一台Ledger Flex内含植入的电路板和线路，可窃取用户的助记词，这是硬件钱包供应链遭入侵范围扩大的最新证据。
updates.what_changed_en: Mark Karpelès confirmed via teardown images and video that a Ledger Flex purchased at Singapore airport's Metapod contained an implanted board and wiring that could steal the user's seed phrase, the latest evidence of an expanding hardware-wallet supply-chain compromise.

updates.title_zh: MediaMarktSaturn在篡改报告后下架Ledger产品
updates.title_en: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
updates.what_changed_zh: MediaMarktSaturn 已将所有 Ledger 产品从门店和线上平台下架，并与制造商联系；此前一名买家报告在两家 MediaMarkt 门店购买的两台 Ledger 钱包内含未授权线缆和蜂窝模块，使调查范围扩大至 CryptoBilis 以外。
updates.what_changed_en: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger products from its stores and online platforms and is in contact with the manufacturer; this follows a buyer reporting two Ledger wallets purchased from separate MediaMarkt stores containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening the investigation beyond CryptoBilis.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 确认 CryptoBilis 渠道设备存在硬件植入，植入物通过读取屏幕截取 24 个助记词并经 LTE/eSIM 外传，且不触碰 Secure Element 或交易签名；所有已确认损失均与 CryptoBilis 渠道设备有关，其他渠道正在核实；CryptoBilis 已暂停销售 Ledger 产品；MediaMarktSaturn 已下架所有 Ledger 产品并与制造商联系；Ledger 称受影响用户总数及损失金额尚未确认，网上数字未经官方核实，建议未初始化设备不要设置、已设置用户转移资产并生成新助记词，调查仍在继续。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger has confirmed hardware implants in CryptoBilis-channel devices; the implant reads the screen to capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization and exfiltrates it over LTE/eSIM without touching the Secure Element or transaction signing; all confirmed losses are linked to CryptoBilis-channel devices, while other channels are being investigated; CryptoBilis has suspended sales of Ledger products; MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger products from its stores and online platforms and is in contact with the manufacturer; Ledger says the total affected-user count and loss amount are not yet confirmed, online figures are unverified, and it advises users not to initialize uninitialized devices and for already-configured users to move assets and generate new seed phrases; the investigation continues.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger hardware wallets from its stores and online platforms after a buyer reported tampered devices containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening Ledger's investigation beyond Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger hardware wallets from its stores and online platforms after a buyer reported tampered devices containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening Ledger's investigation beyond Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.

updates.title_zh: Ledger审查设备销售政策和流程，评估设备防篡改保护措施
updates.title_en: Ledger审查设备销售政策和流程，评估设备防篡改保护措施
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger首席技术官Charles Guillemet表示，公司正在审查面向消费者的设备销售政策和流程，并评估设备的防篡改保护措施；同时提醒用户不要自行拆开可疑硬件钱包，而应寄送Ledger检查。报道还提及此次植入间谍软件事件造成约9000万美元加密货币被盗。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet said the company is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and processes and assessing device tamper-resistance protections; it also urged users not to open suspicious hardware wallets themselves but to send them to Ledger for inspection. The report also mentioned an estimated $90 million in crypto stolen in the spyware-planting incident.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger正在审查其消费者设备销售政策与流程并评估防篡改保护措施，CTO建议用户不要自行拆开可疑钱包；调查已扩展至MediaMarktSaturn等渠道，CryptoBilis停止销售，Trezor和OneKey断绝关系，估计损失约9000万美元。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and processes and assessing tamper-resistance protections, with its CTO advising users not to open suspicious wallets; the investigation has widened to channels such as MediaMarktSaturn, CryptoBilis halted sales, Trezor and OneKey cut ties, and estimated losses are around $90 million.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and assessment of tamper-resistance protections, and urging users not to open suspicious hardware wallets, after spyware-planted devices led to an estimated $90M in stolen crypto.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and assessment of tamper-resistance protections, and urging users not to open suspicious hardware wallets, after spyware-planted devices led to an estimated $90M in stolen crypto.

updates.title_zh: Ledger发现LTE植入物在疑似8600万美元盗取事件中窃取恢复短语
updates.title_en: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.
